Name: AT Pet Raptors
Author: EnbyFelix
Description:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/159091188]Rain/TinCanRaccoon[/url] has graciously allowed an Alternative Textures version to be made of their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13641]Pet Raptor[/url] mod, and recoloring of their sprites. Their mod is so adorable, so I am helping them out and making the conversion for them! Tysm for allowing conversions and recolors!
There are 8 dino textures for any season, as well as seasonal textures, all made by Rain. I also added 4 new dinos, two purple (one with and one without spikes), and two aqua (one with and one without spikes).

Important note: This mod will not change the dino egg sprite, if you want that to change, you can use Rain's CP version linked above.

Downloads.Description: An Alternative Textures conversion of Rain's Pet Raptors mod with permission.
